before-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Bah! Puny humans always try steal Lallis' golden apples! You go away now!

attempting-to-put-anything-in-lalli-s-st.npc: Hey human! You not put things in Lalli's food unless Lalli ask you to! It am very impolite, even for human!

attempting-to-enter-lalli-s-cave.npc: Hey human! You not go in my house! It where me keep all my stuff!

after-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Ha! Stupid human! You no get any golden apples! Even though me much like stone soup!

after-the-fremennik-trials.player: Can I please have some more golden wool?

after-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Me will sell you some golden wool, but me not sell you any golden apples!

after-the-fremennik-trials.player: How much for the golden wool?

after-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Me want 1000 coins! You pay or go!

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:

steps.player: Is that all? Here you go!

steps.npc: Ha! Stupid human think he buy golden apples, but actually get stupid wool! Hahaha!

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have that much cash on me...

steps.npc: Well stupid bad trade human don't get no wool then! Or any golden apples!
You no pay, then you go! You no get any golden apples!

using-a-bowl-on-lalli-s-stew-after-quest.npc: Hey human! You not go back on deal! Me know you stupid at trades but that stone mine now! All soup mine!
